note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the soldier is recorded for this species, neither the alate nor the worker being described in the original; the asterisked head width measurement is estimated from the figure of the 1960 original description; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and rostrum brown with a smoky tinge; antennae smoky brown; thorax, abdominal dorsum and femora brown. Head and abdominal tergites without long setae; pronotum with many short setae; legs and abdominal sternites with long and short setae. Body length 4.30–4.50 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped excluding the rostrum, with a distinct constriction behind the antennae (1.90–1.95 mm including the rostrum, 1.30 mm excluding the rostrum, maximum width 1.20 mm, width at the constriction 0.78 mm); in lateral view strongly incurved behind the rostrum, occiput distinctly raised, without rostral swelling; posterior part strongly projecting (posterior bulge 0.50–0.55 mm; head bulge index, i.e. posterior bulge/head length without rostrum, 0.38–0.42). Rostrum cylindrical; slightly shorter than half the head length (0.60–0.65 mm long; rostrum length/head length without rostrum index 0.462–0.50). Eyes small, white, indistinct, situated behind the antennae. Antennae very long, 14-segmented; 3rd segment about 2 times to two and a half times the length of the 2nd; 4th segment about 2 times the length of the 2nd, shorter than the 3rd. Mandibles reduced, each with a long dark brown spine-like process. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; about half as long as wide (0.30–0.32 mm long, 0.60–0.62 mm wide). Hind tibia 2.0 mm long.
